name: WA-7 waitress droid
description: The WA-7 waitress droid was a type of droid of the WA-series used in restaurants and diners. FLO was a WA-7 droid that was used in Dex's Diner on Coruscant. On the planet Stobar, a WA-7 named Marwigo was employed by the Plop Dribble's diner. At least one WA-7 droid worked at the Gilroy Plaza Diner. One WA-7 served aboard the Rebel Alliance starship Silver Arrow, which fell under attack from the Scourge during the "scourge of the droids." Like the rest of the ship's droid pool, the WA-7 was infected and became a vessel for the Scourge, which murdered every living being aboard. When Magna Tolvan's crew investigated the disappearance of the Silver Arrow and boarded it, the Scourge used the WA-7 and the rest of the corrupted droids to ambush them.
